title: City Data (Shared Facts)
description: Shared city facts that are true regardless of which client serves that city. One file per city at data/cities/<city-slug>.json. Client-relative fields (HQ distance, dispatch time, map-iframe title) live in per-client overlay files at data/cities/<client-slug>/<city-slug>.json — see city-overlay.schema.json. A missing overlay for the active client at build time = SC-2 fail-loud (never fall back to another client's values).

name_with_state.description: Full name with state code (e.g., 'Vienna, VA'). Omit only for jurisdictions where state suffix is non-standard (e.g., 'Washington, DC' uses this field; stand-alone 'DC' would not).

county.description: County or independent jurisdiction name (e.g., 'Fairfax County').

county_full.description: Full county with state (e.g., 'Fairfax County, Virginia').

population.description: City population (most recent census or ACS estimate). Year-stamp the source in _comment or a sibling _population_source field. Required for the Service Area Information card (blueprint §6b).

population_source.description: Source and year for the population figure (e.g., '2020 US Census', '2023 ACS 5-year estimate').

zip_codes.description: ZIP codes served in this city. Required for the Service Area Information card (blueprint §6b). Every city must have at least one.

electric_utilities.description: Electric utility provider(s) serving this city.

utility_coordination_phrase.description: Descriptive phrase about utility coordination for this city.

permit_authority.description: Jurisdiction-specific permitting authority. Typically needed for DC or independent cities.

geographic_anchor_paragraph.description: 2-3 sentence location description providing geographic context.

audience_descriptor.description: Target audience description including neighborhood references.

neighborhoods.description: Array of neighborhood objects for this city.

neighborhood_examples.description: Comma-separated neighborhoods with this housing type.

context_paragraph.description: Historical/technical context about this housing era.

symptoms.description: Common electrical/service problems in this housing type.

housing_patterns.description: Array of housing pattern objects covering the city's building stock eras.

quick_ref_localized_items.description: Service-slug-keyed object. Each key is a service slug; value is an array of localized Q&A items for that service in this city.

most_common_problem_paragraph.description: Service-slug-keyed object. Each key is a service slug; value is a 1-2 sentence summary of the most common problem for that service in this city.

specific_problems_neighborhood_phrase.description: Service-slug-keyed object. Each key is a service slug; value describes neighborhood-specific problem patterns.

ev_charger_homes_phrase.description: Phrase about EV charger readiness in older homes in this city.

area_served_schema.description: JSON-LD areaServed entries for structured data.
